notes: No published 4-year plan exists for this specialization: the catalog's 'Catalog four-year plan' section only links out to the College of Agriculture and Natural Resources' general roadmap page (4yearplans.umd.edu), with no AGST-specific term grid. This plan is CONSTRUCTED from the catalog's own requirement rows instead (docs/project/owner-review.md flags this). Gen Ed courses are left out; only the major is audited.

Organic Chemistry gateway filled with CHEM231 & CHEM232; PLSC275 would satisfy it equally. Biology Laboratory filled with BSCI180; BSCI161 would satisfy it equally. Plant Protection gateway filled with BSCI337; BSCI487 or BSCI497 would satisfy it equally.
Animal Management Course filled with ANSC232, one of seven named options.

The three 'AGST, PLSC or ANSC', 'AREC or BMGT' and 'AGST or PLSC x3' restricted-elective slots (all advisor-chosen, 300-level or above) are filled with ANSC401 (Animal Growth and Development), BMGT313 (Entrepreneurship), and AGST333, AGST426, AGST440 (all real 300+ courses in the named departments); the ENST Restricted Elective is filled with ENST411 (Principles of Soil Fertility, named directly in the Environmental Horticulture specialization's own list). The Multidiscipline Restricted Elective (Education, Computer Science or Policy) is filled with CMSC106, a real 100-level Computer Science course; see the owner-review.md flag on this slot's ambiguous department wording.
